summary: IDS feed s094_single is degraded due to severe tool overload: 4.70 Gbps bursts on a 1 Gbps IDS port (470% capacity). All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, drops) are healthy, but overload will cause packet drops and missed detections without broker remediation.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering full unfiltered traffic bursts peaking at 4.70 Gbps to a single 1 Gbps IDS port with no load balancing or aggregation. 2 intervals exceeded the 80% overload threshold, indicating sustained oversubscription at the broker egress.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot ingest 470% of its line rate - it will drop packets randomly under load, miss exploit payloads and C2 callbacks, create incomplete flows and false negatives, and lose detection coverage despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute 4.7 Gbps bursts across ~5x 1 Gbps IDS members via 5-tuple load balancing to keep each tool under 80% utilization, preserving full payload and bidirectional visibility without drops.
